title: Large Language Model-Powered Evolutionary Code Optimization on a Phylogenetic Tree

mechanism.domainTask: Trajectory-conditioned GPU code optimization for scientific-computing algorithms across hardware backends
mechanism.populationDetail: A forest partitions search into multiple semi-isolated lineages, each represented by an operational phylogenetic tree whose nodes store candidate algorithms and whose edges encode modifications/rewards.
mechanism.archiveDetail: A global Elite Pool retains top-k trajectories across trees and high-value modifications for cross-lineage reuse; it is distinct from the tree population.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Positive-reward offspring are inserted as child nodes; hopeless branches and low-potential nodes/trees are pruned while informative failures may be retained; elite trajectories/modifications are updated separately.
mechanism.generationDetail: NextStepper/ModifyAgent make localized minimal-diff changes to one selected parent node, while Designer can make holistic architectural or algorithmic redesigns from an elite node to seed a new tree.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Successful execution returns a scalar runtime score; failures return structured success/failure and a reason, with traces used for debugging and future context. Correctness is a gate as well as metadata.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: One focal node is sampled within a selected tree using reward, recent improvement, depth and temperature; forest-level tree choice also uses performance, potential and diversity. Designer separately starts from an elite-pool node.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Trajectory-conditioned in-context reinforcement learning / algorithm distillation treats full modification-state-reward trajectories as reusable learning signals, beyond conventional prompt-conditioned mutation labels.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL-POWERED EVOLUTIONARY CODE OPTIMIZATION ON A PHYLOGENETIC TREE.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Tree is a maintained candidate/search structure, not only lineage visualization. Survey already cites it in tree population and structure-based parent-selection discussions, but not yet in Elite Archive, generation, model assignment, evaluation-feedback, or adaptive explore-exploit subsections. Replacement label combines positive-reward insertion and pruning; debug retries are repairs rather than repeated measurement.
